newsitem.title: CHINA: Train crash in central China kills at least 90.
newsitem.headline: Train crash in central China kills at least 90.

text.p: Two passenger trains collided on Tuesday in China's central Hunan province, killing 90 people and injuring more than 300, the Xinhua news agency said.
The crash occurred at 10.48 a.m. (0248 GMT) at the Rongjiawan station on one of China's main railway linkes linking the capital, Beijing, with the southern boomtown of Guangzhou, it said.

The No 324 train, travelling north from the southwestern city of Kunming, capital of Yunnan province, to Zhengzhou, capital of central Henan province, collided with the rear of stationary train, it said.
The collision derailed 13 carriages of the two trains, it said.
